description.narrative: The UNECE Policy Recommendation N46 has been adopted at the 27th UN/CEFACT Plenary of by UNECE Member States in April 2021. The document (as submitted to the 27th Plenary of the UN/CEFACT Working Party) is available in English, French and Russian (page 6). Based on the IPs email uploaded in the library, 13 CSOs have been actively contributing to the development of the policy recommendation including: Clean Clothes Campaign (The Netherlands Global network), Fashion Revolution (UK Global Network), Freedom Fund (UK), Industry All (Switzerland Global Network), Fair Wear Foundation (The Netherlands), Hecho por Nosotros (Argentina Global Network), World Fair Trade Organization (The Netherlands Global Network), Textile Exchange (Malaysia Global Network), Goodwear International (United States Global Network), HEJ Support (Germany), Sustainable Leather Foundation (UK), Get it Fair (Italy), Cittadellarte (Italy). There is no obvious risk of doublecounting. No apparent possible bias is detected. Sexdisaggregation has not been provided, nor age, only by country.
